Salicylic Acid Cleanser.description: Salicylic acid helps to deeply cleanse pores, reduce excess oil, and exfoliate dead skin cells, making it effective for treating acne and improving skin clarity for oily and combination skin types.

Gel Moisturizer.description: Gel moisturizers provide hydration without adding excess oil, making them suitable for oily skin to maintain moisture balance without clogging pores.

Rich Cream Moisturizer.description: Rich cream moisturizers are designed to provide intense hydration and nourishment, which is essential for dry skin that lacks moisture and may feel tight or flaky.

Hydrating Serum.description: Hydrating serums often contain ingredients like hyaluronic acid that can attract and retain moisture in the skin, making them beneficial for dry skin to boost hydration levels.

Barrier Repair Moisturizer.description: Barrier repair moisturizers contain ingredients like ceramides, panthenol, and centella would help strengthen and restore the skin's natural barrier, which is crucial for sensitive skin that is prone to irritation and inflammation.

Gentle Fragrance-Free Cleanser.description: Gentle fragrance-free cleansers are formulated to cleanse the skin without stripping away natural oils or causing irritation, making them ideal for sensitive skin that can react to harsh ingredients.

Lightweight Barrier-Supporting Moisturiz.description: Lightweight barrier-supporting moisturizers provide balanced hydration and help maintain the skin's natural barrier without being too heavy or greasy, making them suitable for combination skin that has both oily and dry areas.

Broad-Spectrum Sunscreen.description: Broad-spectrum sunscreen SPF 30-50 is essential for protecting the skin from harmful UV rays and preventing sun damage, which is important for maintaining healthy skin regardless of skin type.

Lightweight Moisturizer.description: Lightweight moisturizers provide hydration without being too heavy, making them suitable for normal skin to maintain a balanced and healthy complexion.

Leave-On Salicylic Acid (BHA).description: Leave-on salicylic acid (BHA) products are effective for treating acne because they penetrate deep into the pores to exfoliate and clear out excess oil, dead skin cells, and impurities that can lead to breakouts.

Lightweight Non-Comedogenic Moisturizer.description: Lightweight non-comedogenic moisturizers provide necessary hydration without clogging pores, which is important for acne-prone skin to maintain moisture balance while preventing further breakouts.

Retinoid Serum.description: Retinoid serums are highly effective for addressing signs of aging such as wrinkles and fine lines because they promote collagen production, increase cell turnover, and improve skin texture and firmness over time.

Antioxidant Serum.description: Antioxidant serums containing ingredients like vitamin C, E, and ferulic acid can help to protect skin from environmental damage, reduce inflammation, and improve overall skin health by neutralizing free radicals.

Vitamin C Serum.description: Vitamin C serums are effective for brightening the skin and reducing the appearance of dark spots and hyperpigmentation by inhibiting melanin production and providing antioxidant protection.

Benzoyl Peroxide Spot Treatment.description: Benzoyl peroxide kills acne-causing bacteria (C. acnes) and helps to unclog pores. Use as a spot treatment for inflamed breakouts. Not for sensitive or dry skin types.

Peptide Firming Serum.description: Peptides signal the skin to produce more collagen and elastin, improving firmness and reducing fine lines without irritation, making them suitable for sensitive skin that cannot tolerate retinoids.

Centella Asiatica Soothing Ampoule.description: A concentrated ampoule with centella asiatica (cica), madecassoside, and green tea extract to rapidly calm redness, stinging, and inflammation. Ideal for reactive or compromised skin barriers.

Hyaluronic Acid + B5 Hydration Treatment.description: A treatment serum with multiple weights of hyaluronic acid and vitamin B5 that draws water into the skin and holds it there. Crucial for dehydrated skin (which can be oily or dry).

Tranexamic Acid + Kojic Acid Dark Spot C.description: A targeted treatment combining tranexamic acid, kojic acid, and niacinamide to inhibit melanin production and fade post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (PIH), melasma, and sun spots without irritation.

Niacinamide + Licorice Root Repair Treat.description: Niacinamide (vitamin B3) helps repair UV-induced DNA damage, reduces sunburn cells, and improves barrier function. Licorice root extract fades existing sun spots and calms inflammation.
